metadata.title: Digital Service Standards Control Catalog - Performance and Reliability

props.name: keywords
props.value: IM8, GovTech, Singapore, digital service standards, Performance and Reliability

props.name: rationale
props.value: Services that are not effective incur unnecessary costs for the organisation.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Review digital services every {{ insert: param, pr-1_prm_1 }} day(s). Shut down services that are no longer needed or fail to meet their intended objectives.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose:
Review factors such as relevance, importance and usage rates of the service.Ensure that there is a process to review each digital service such as websites and mobile apps periodically.
Review factors such as relevance, importance and usage rates of the service.

guidelines.prose: The time period in days within which a digital service review must be conducted.

props.name: rationale
props.value: A centralised registry and tracking of digital services across Whole-of-Government facilitates central oversight and benchmarking of digital services. WOGAA implementation enables analytics data and feedback collection that is essential to identifying issues and opportunities for continuous improvement of the digital service.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Register and implement WOGAA on all public facing digital services.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose:
Registration and implementation includes:
* Registration of all public facing digital services
* Implementation of WOGAA tracking code
* Enabling Sentiments
Refer to Setup Guide for details.
Only registration is required for SaaS and COTS products that do not allow customisation and the implementation of the tracking code and sentiments.

props.name: rationale
props.value: End users expect to have access to digital channels anytime excluding planned and unplanned downtime.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose:
Make digital services available to users 24/7.
Clearly communicate the operational hours if a service cannot be available 24/7.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Do not limit the availability of services to specific hours unless justified by operational or business requirements.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Awareness of scheduled downtime minimises disruption to users by allowing them to plan around it.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Provide notice of scheduled downtime at least {{ insert: param, pr-4_prm_1 }} day(s) in advance.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose:
Clearly communicate scheduled downtime using methods like maintenance banners and in-app notifications. Useful information include date, time, duration, and reason for the downtime (if applicable), feature(s) or section(s) of the digital service that will be unavailable (if applicable).
Balance between providing enough lead time, and ensuring that end users can remember when the maintenance will happen.

guidelines.prose: The time period in days to provide notice of schedule downtime.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Broken links affect content delivery and prevent end users from completing tasks. Digital services with many broken links are perceived as untrustworthy and unreliable.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Establish processes to detect broken links, and address them within {{ insert: param, pr-5_prm_1 }} day(s) from detection.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Use automated tools like WOGAA's broken link scanner to regularly scan for broken links. This applies to both internal and external links.

guidelines.prose: The time period in days to address broken links.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Browser incompatibility can cause layout bugs and other functional issues.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Ensure web-based services are compatible with the latest major versions of at least {{ insert: param, pr-6_prm_1 }} widely used web browsers, based on usage statistics.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose:
Regularly test your service on the latest two major versions of popular browsers such as Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Get browser usage data from analytics tools.
Consider using browser compatibility tools like BrowserStack or LambdaTest to automate and expand testing across multiple environments.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Long page load times frustrate end users and lead to longer transaction times and increased abandonment rate.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Ensure that page load time of web-based services is {{ insert: param, pr-7_prm_1 }} second(s) or less.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Track or regularly test and optimise performance using tools like WOGAA and Google PageSpeed Insights.

guidelines.prose: The time period in seconds for page load times.
